description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called TalkOverlayView for a macOS application. It manages a visual overlay with interactive elements such as a circular orb, a close button, and animated wave rings, primarily used for a talk or voice interface. It includes nested SwiftUI views and an NSViewRepresentable for macOS-specific interactions.

classes.name: OrbInteractionNSView
classes.description: A subclass of NSView handling mouse interactions (click, drag, release) to trigger callback closures for single click, double click, and drag start.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and configures an NSView that detects mouse interactions, attaching callback closures.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the NSView with new callback closures.

methods.name: mouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events, differentiating between single and double clicks, and initiates drag detection.

methods.name: mouseDragged
methods.description: Handles dragging, calculates movement, and triggers drag start callback.

methods.name: mouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse release, triggers single click callback if appropriate.
